_description: AGV B (TN) — base towing AGV, no SLMP/PLC, with pusher actuator and lidar

networking._comment: LOCAL_IP is a placeholder — verify AGV B PC address before deploy

motor_channels._comment: DO and AO channel indices for each motor drive — same as AGV A

pusher_channels._comment: DO channel indices for the double-acting electric linear actuator

horn_channels._comment: DO channel indices for the horn (shared with pusher extend)

motor_cal._comment: 2026-07-09: INDEPENDENT per-wheel fit from _calibration/ runs 15:16 (left) + 15:09 (right), R^2~0.99. motor_rpm = RPM_PER_VOLT*V + RPM_VOLT_OFFSET. Right has more deadband (more negative offset) so it gets more voltage for the same target -> AGV runs straight. Mean matches the prior shared 1259.29/-82.54 so overall speed is unchanged.

speeds._comment_manual_accel: Manual jog acceleration in m/s^2. Applies on button press only; release = instant stop (no deceleration). Set to 2x ACCEL_RATE so manual feels more responsive than auto.

pid_tuning._comment_high: 2026-07-09: derivative sign bug in core/pid.py fixed (it ignored error_sign, so with the rear sensor error_sign=+1 the D term was ANTI-damping — larger TD grew the weave). With the fix TD now damps: raised 0.062 -> 0.1 as a conservative start; step TD up on track (0.1->0.2->0.3) until the weave is smooth, back off if wheels twitch on tape noise. KP kept at 1.56.
pid_tuning._comment_slow: SLOW: matches HIGH; step TD together with HIGH during tuning.
pid_tuning._comment_shared: Integral ENABLED — deadband-gated (|e|<5mm) removes steady bias on straights. TI_MAX caps i_term contribution to ~66 rpm.
pid_tuning._comment_sr: Speed reduction — deep SR_CAP (50%) and high V_RED_COEF needed because wheels are forward-only. SR_ALPHA=0.1 preserves ~0.5s time constant at DT=50ms.

sequences._comment: Tag 10 ARRIVAL — AGV arrives at home: stop, pusher DOWN, set at_home, return to ARMED
sequences.name: tag10

sequences._comment: Tag 10 DEPARTURE — AGV starts from home: stop, pusher UP (5s), clear at_home, resume HIGH
sequences.name: tag10

sequences._comment: Tag 20 — slow speed for corners and sequence approaches
sequences.name: tag20_slow

sequences._comment: Tag 30 — resume HIGH speed on straights
sequences.name: tag30_high

sequences._comment: Tag 40 — stop, pusher DOWN (5s), resume at current speed
sequences.name: tag40_pusher_down

sequences._comment: Tag 50 — stop, pusher UP (5s), resume at current speed
sequences.name: tag50_pusher_up

features._comment: SLMP disabled — no PLC on AGV B. LIDAR_STOP_ENABLED is now driven by the runtime UI toggle (defaults ON at boot regardless of this value); kept here only as a deployment hint.
